Cost: 2,500eb (V. Expensive)

Before Myers declared war, Militech engineers were asked: How can you equip grunts with superheavy armor and weapons without a full ACPA while avoiding cyberpsychosis? Ultimately, they stripped a Linear Frame to its core components and dedicated all hydraulic power to the legs and hips. These ‘Wolfpack’ frames were highly praised during the war, especially by Militech special forces. Nowadays though, the Wolfpack lets BARGHEST lug around giant guns to mow down gangers with.

The Wolfpack Linear Frame can only be bought as an External Frame. For installation as an External Frame, two installations of Interface Plugs are required. While connected properly to the frame, the total REF and MOVE penalty applied to the user (if any) from worn armor and wielded weapons is reduced by 2, or by 1 for any form of MetalGear (Minimum 0). This frame cannot increase the user's BODY in any way, nor modify their HP or Death Save.

Foundry notes:

  • While connected, your total REF and MOVE penalty from worn armor and wielded weapons drops by 2, or by 1 for any Metalgear (minimum 0); apply by hand.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Gear, Drugs, & Frames > External Linear Frames).
